verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt lists first-party Webhooks with a dedicated getting-started guide, and describes them as a way to 'get notified when something changes'. That confirms the product ships a webhook capability, but the evidence is a single one-line mention. It does not show how subscriptions are registered or which events are available. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (API or UI), list of subscribable event types, payload/delivery details (retries, signing), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
